guide: Download and install the Zoom app for macOS from zoom.us/download.
Open Finder, go to Applications, and double-click zoom.us to launch it.
Click Sign In and log in using your account or SSO credentials.

Click Join and enter a Meeting ID and Passcode to enter a meeting.
